opportunity.added.meaning: Confirms that the person added an opportunity Behavior to today at a time or in a time range.

opportunity.logged.meaning: Confirms that Done now added an opportunity Behavior to today and marked it Completed at the current time.

opportunity.removed.meaning: Confirms that the person removed an added item from today, or from Needs decision, back to the opportunity basket.
opportunity.removed.text: {title} removed. It stays in your opportunities.

opportunity.added-from.meaning: Marks a Timeline row that was added from the opportunity basket, and who added it.
opportunity.added-from.text: {source, select, daily_brief {Added from Daily Brief} chat {Added in Chat} mcp {Added by a connected app} other {Added}}

opportunity.no-schedule.meaning: Says on the Behavior form and list that an opportunity Behavior has no fixed schedule and is added to a day by hand.
opportunity.no-schedule.text: No fixed schedule. Add it to today when there is a chance.

opportunity.refused.not-available.meaning: Refuses an add because the Behavior is no longer available as an opportunity, or it is archived or gone.
opportunity.refused.not-available.text: {title} is no longer available as an opportunity.
opportunity.refused.not-available.label: Not added

opportunity.refused.not-running.meaning: Refuses an add because the Behavior has ended or is paused at the chosen time.
opportunity.refused.not-running.text: {title} is not running at that time.
opportunity.refused.not-running.label: Not added

opportunity.refused.not-today.meaning: Refuses an add for a day other than today in the Behavior's timezone, such as a basket left open past midnight.
opportunity.refused.not-today.text: Opportunities can be added to today only.
opportunity.refused.not-today.label: Not added

opportunity.refused.time.meaning: Refuses an add whose time is not a whole minute, or whose range starts and ends at the same time.
opportunity.refused.time.text: Choose a time, or a range that ends at a different time.
opportunity.refused.time.label: Not added

opportunity.remove-refused.marked.meaning: Refuses Remove because the added item is already marked Completed or Not Completed.
opportunity.remove-refused.marked.text: {title} is already marked, so it stays.
opportunity.remove-refused.marked.label: Not removed

opportunity.remove-refused.kept.meaning: Refuses Remove because the added item has a Note, tracked time, an earlier mark or a connected activity.
opportunity.remove-refused.kept.text: {title} has a Note, tracked time, an earlier mark or a connected activity, so it stays.
opportunity.remove-refused.kept.label: Not removed

opportunity.remove-refused.not-found.meaning: Refuses Remove because the item is not an added opportunity in the person's account, for example after another device removed it.
opportunity.remove-refused.not-found.text: This item is no longer on today's Timeline.
opportunity.remove-refused.not-found.label: Not removed

opportunity.failed.meaning: Says an add, Done now or Remove did not reach Cadence, so nothing changed.
opportunity.failed.text: Cadence could not change today's items. Try again.
